scope: GFX100RF fixed 35mm F4 vendor-corrected RAF geometry to DNG WarpRectilinear calibration

decoder_control.method: render each RAF with the same decoder and lens correction off/on; mutual SIFT feature matches; robust radial least-squares with a held-out split

admitted_full_strength_green_model.strength_policy: linearly blend the vendor-calibration delta from the metadata-derived fit; preserve per-plane Fuji CA deltas

decision.h1_remove_common_scale: rejected; it worsens holdout median error by more than 21x versus 0.9.3
decision.h2_refit_vendor_radial_curve: accepted; holdout median and p90 improve by about 55% and 61% at the measurement scale
decision.h3_center: accepted as a small jointly fitted offset; requires final Phocus visual confirmation

claim_boundary: This is a five-scene calibration against Apple vendor RAW correction for the single geometric profile observed in 19 local GFX100RF RAFs. It does not reveal Fujifilm's proprietary algorithm, prove all firmware versions, or replace final Phocus full-resolution validation.
